LESSON: WRITING 14.5.1 CREATIVE WRITING: DESCRIPTIVE WRITING (200 – 240 WORDS)

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.5: Writing 14.5.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Writing (200 – 240 words)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 14.5.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Writing (200 – 240 words), part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you describe your best friend? 2. How can you describe some things in your school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 14.5.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Writing (200 – 240 words) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: A learner writes clearly and creatively when writing the descriptive composition.

● Communication and Collaboration: A learner engages in peer review of each other’s work, thus improving quality.

Values:
Unity: A learner engages each other to view videos or pictures of people, things, or places.

Link to other subjects:

● Performing arts: A sense of creativity is required in scripting texts for performance,

● All languages: Writing is key to mastery of any language.
